rcb-pp-seasons-above-league.label: Seasons with RCB powerplay run rate above the league
rcb-pp-seasons-above-league.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches (Cricsheet ball-by-ball, IPL 2008–2026)
rcb-pp-seasons-above-league.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) THEN d.total_runs END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END), 2) AS rcb, ROUND(SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END), 2) AS league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) AS rcbBalls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

rcb-pp-innings.label: RCB innings with a result
rcb-pp-innings.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches (Cricsheet ball-by-ball, IPL 2008–2026)
rcb-pp-innings.filters: Regulation innings, matches with a winner
rcb-pp-innings.query: WITH pp AS ( SELECT i.innings_id, i.match_id, i.innings_number, i.batting_team_id, SUM(d.total_runs) pp_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL AND dm.kind NOT IN ('retired hurt') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pp_wkts FROM innings i JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = i.innings_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY i.innings_id) SELECT pp.*, i.runs total, m.winner_id, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN pp.batting_team_id IN (2,15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_rcb, CASE WHEN m.winner_id = pp.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won FROM pp JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = pp.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = pp.match_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL

pp-sr-v-kohli.query: SELECT p.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.player_out_id = d.batter_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_boundary = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) boundaries, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 0 AND d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dots FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id = d.batter_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 GROUP BY d.batter_id HAVING balls >= 60 ORDER BY balls DESC

pp-by-season.label: Powerplay run rate by season: RCB vs IPL
pp-by-season.dataset: CricField warehouse: deliveries ⨝ innings ⨝ matches (Cricsheet ball-by-ball, IPL 2008–2026)
pp-by-season.filters: Overs 1–6, regulation innings (super overs excluded); run rate = all runs ÷ legal balls × 6
pp-by-season.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) AS year, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) THEN d.total_runs END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END), 2) AS rcb, ROUND(SUM(d.total_runs) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END), 2) AS league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (2,15) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 END) AS rcbBalls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND d.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 5 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
